source_documents.title: Novel Y-shaped multi-stimuli responsive pyrene substituted quinoxaline and pyridopyrazine-based push-pull molecules showing solvatochromism, aggregation induced excimer emission, acidofluorochromism and moisture detection

reference_evidence_units.quote: For 3a and 3d, red-shift of 105 nm and 91 nm was observed, respectively, on increasing solvent polarity from toluene to DMSO.
reference_evidence_units.subject: 3a

reference_evidence_units.quote: justifies the possibility of TICT process in these molecules
reference_evidence_units.subject: 3a-d
reference_evidence_units.statement: TICT proposed from polarity-dependent shifts and twisted structure.

reference_evidence_units.quote: In 3a, there is a dual emission at 10% THF-H2O mixture due to presence of both monomer and excimer species.
reference_evidence_units.subject: 3a
reference_evidence_units.statement: Monomer and excimer bands; 493 nm aggregate band with more water.

reference_evidence_units.quote: When the concentration was increased to 10− 2 M, this peak diminished, giving rise to a new peak at 501 nm with enhanced emission compared to previous concentrations
reference_evidence_units.subject: 3a

reference_evidence_units.quote: Crystal structure of 3a showed twisted structure with herringbone packing arrangement and intermolecular π-π stacking of pyrene units.
reference_evidence_units.subject: 3a
reference_evidence_units.statement: Pyrene π-π stacking in the crystal.

reference_evidence_units.quote: might be occuring as a result of photo-induced electron transfer (PET) in the protonated forms of 3a-d from electron donor pyrene to the pro tonated quinoxaline ring
reference_evidence_units.subject: protonated 3a-d
reference_evidence_units.statement: Tentative PET quenching in the protonated form.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Concerns the protonated species, not the input molecule.

reference_mechanisms.label: ICT_TICT_CT
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Pyrene-donor/quinoxaline-acceptor ICT gives strong solvatochromism; TICT is proposed for polar solvents and moisture sensing.

reference_mechanisms.label: AGGREGATE_EXCITON_EXCIMER
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Aggregation- and concentration-induced pyrene excimer emission, with π-stacked pyrenes in the crystal.
